description: A jQuery plugin for alert, confirm, and prompt dialog boxes with accessibility support and customizable options.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Displays an alert dialog with a message, optional title, and callback.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog with a message, optional title, and callback.

methods.name: prompt
methods.description: Displays a prompt dialog with a message, default value, optional title, and callback.
